with c as (select customer_id, signup_date from (select *, row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by _loaded_at desc, _run_id desc) rn from `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.customers`) where rn=1 and signup_date between '2026-08-01' and '2026-08-31'),
o as (select * from (select *, row_number() over (partition by order_id order by _loaded_at desc, _run_id desc) rn from `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.orders`) where rn=1)
select count(*) signups,
 countif(exists(select 1 from o where o.customer_id=c.customer_id and o.order_date<='2026-10-10')) bought_by_oct10,
 countif(exists(select 1 from o where o.customer_id=c.customer_id and o.order_date<='2026-10-10' and o.status<>'cancelled')) bought_noncancelled,
 countif(exists(select 1 from o where o.customer_id=c.customer_id and o.order_date>=c.signup_date and o.order_date<=date_add(c.signup_date, interval 29 day))) within30,
 countif(exists(select 1 from o where o.customer_id=c.customer_id and o.order_date<c.signup_date and o.order_date<='2026-10-10')) order_before_signup
from c
